recent_news.title: Live updates: BTC above $65,000 even as the Senate punts the CLARITY Act to the fall

recent_news.summary_ko: 상원이 휴회 전에 암호화폐 법안을 통과시키지 않은 가운데에도 시장은 상승했으며, 꾸준한 ETF 유입과 약한 달러가 워싱턴보다 가격에 더 많은 역할을 했습니다.

recent_news.title: Is Clarity's delay a blessing in disguise?: State of Crypto
recent_news.summary: The crypto industry is angry and disappointed that the Senate is not holding a procedural vote on the Clarity Act this month, but that isn't the worst possible outcome.

recent_news.title: U.S. Senate opens first stage of crypto Clarity Act voting to give bill a chance next month

recent_news.summary_ko: 다수당 지도자는 상원이 60표 장애물을 넘어 법안을 처리하려고 할 때 따르는 다단계 프로세스를 시작했기 때문에 9월에도 여전히 기회가 있습니다.

recent_news.title: Majority Leader Thune files cloture on Clarity Act, setting up Sept. 15 Senate vote
recent_news.summary: The Senate is set to vote on the motion on Tuesday, Sept. 15, the day after the body returns, though at least seven non-Republicans will need to support it.
